content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Idaho Falls

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify that your education and project-management experience meet PMI's requirements for PMP certification. Review the specific hour thresholds tied to your degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all scheduled sessions synchronously, engage with instructors and peers in real time, and complete the full curriculum to earn your 35 contact hours of formal education.

steps_items.heading: Apply to PMI and Pay Fee
steps_items.text: Submit your official PMI application with your education and work history. Once PMI approves your eligibility, pay the examination fee to activate your testing window. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the application portal and deadlines.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor office hours to strengthen weak areas. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Plan to dedicate focused study time in the weeks before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) throughout each three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—education, mentoring, and volunteering—to help you sustain your certification.
